constraints.description: Every phase-plan detail and acceptance criterion maps to direct semantic-contract, coverage-ledger, validator, unit, BDD, or clean-gate evidence.

validation.validation_method: Run the focused validator and BDD suite, then map the shared domain, scenarios, capabilities, artifacts, and showcases to the phase plan.

constraints.description: All declared evidence paths exist and are non-empty, JSON reports parse, strict OpenSpec validation passes, and no task remains unchecked before archive.

validation.validation_method: Parse ledgers and reports, stat every evidence path, scan tasks, and run strict OpenSpec validation.

constraints.description: The validator rejects missing, stale, duplicate, malformed, and nonexistent implemented evidence rather than throwing or silently accepting drift.

validation.validation_method: Run the adversarial mutation test suite and focused Cucumber feature.

constraints.description: Semantic coverage readiness is not presented as completed showcase behavior, browser/device proof, full 3.0 certification, registry authority, or npm latest readiness.

validation.validation_method: Require in-progress coverage, five planned showcase evidence states, explicit downstream owners, and publication denial.

constraints.description: Screenshots are non-applicable only for this headless contract; real browser, device, accessibility, trace, video, and hash evidence remains mandatory for downstream examples and Docusaurus.

validation.validation_method: Review the evidence medium and every showcase's downstream visual owner.

constraints.description: The contract preserves canonical normalized entities, ID-only lists, separate local patches, and component-to-hook-to-store or adapter I/O ownership.

validation.validation_method: Validate scenario invariants and compare the documentation language with repository architecture rules.

global_rules: Do not authorize or perform registry publication.
Do not count planned paths as implemented runtime or visual evidence.
Do not weaken or reinterpret the phase-plan acceptance criteria.
Do not fabricate screenshots for a headless data contract.
termination_conditions: Focused validator and BDD gates pass from the current worktree.
Strict OpenSpec validation and evidence-integrity checks pass.
No unsupported showcase, platform, visual, certification, or publication claim remains.
